fact: The document is the text of Tanzania's Access to Information Act, 2016 (Chapter 149), assented to on 23 September 2016, gazetted on 30 September 2016 and commenced on 1 July 2017 by the Access to Information (Date of Commencement) Notice, 2017; it gives every citizen a right to request information from public bodies and applies to Mainland Tanzania only.
Civil society at an LHRC workshop discuss amending the Access to Information Act of 2016, whose section 5(1) gives every person the right to access information.
